notes.title: 2024.7 Patch 2 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today, we have another small update that addresses several bugfixes:

[list]
[*] [b]Story Mode Crash[/b] - We identified and fixed an issue that would cause the game to get hung up during the beginning of Story Mode due to no audio devices being identified by the game.
[*] [b]Settings Menu Crash[/b] - We identified and fixed an issue that could cause the game to crash while performing input remapping in the settings menu if the captured inputs did not match the control type being remapped.
[*] [b]Settings Menu Improvement[/b] - We've improved when the game stores the current settings to ensure they are retained even if the application is force-closed. This should improve some of the reports we've gotten of input remapping or other settings changes not 'sticking'.
[*] [b]Settings Menu Improvement[/b] - We fixed an issue that could cause the mobile edition's control configuration view to display when quickly shuffling through the settings views.
[*] [b]Build Version Improvement[/b] - We have updated the indicator on the main menu to show the full build version, which now includes the version code for each release.
[/list]

notes.title: 2024.7 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We've just launched our 2024.7 update for KONSUI FIGHTER. Here are the highlights:

[list]
[*] [b]New Versus Flow[/b] - This update brings the new versus flow into the game! After each match, the fighters will now exchange a brief dialogue, and your victories will accrue in the form of trophy coins. You also now have the option to jump right back into the action via rematch, or hop back to the main menu to select different fighters!
[*] [b]Gameplay Updates and Fixes[/b] - With this update, we've corrected at least one significant flaw in the core gameplay mechanics that led to unintended damage buffs. We've also adjusted a few of the cornered scenarios we tweaked in the last update to put a little more 'oomph' back into those options. 
[*] [b]Various Bug Fixes[/b] - Fixed an issue with the Game Over screen that could lead to a soft crash. Improved a few aspects of establishing network connections to improve reliability.
[/list]
